reading.title: Zuckerberg wins Meta deal to help him foot bill for possible California billionaire tax
reading.summary: The Meta boss had said he would exit the state over a wealth tax that has not yet come into force.

news.title: Argentina drops investigation into President Milei over crypto fraud
news.summary: Javier Milei had denied acting fraudulently when a cryptocurrency nosedived after he deleted a social media post about it.
